claims.statement: For MSR12 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, certified-log scaled table/rank/hash/window program with FIXED c0=7/10 otherwise) recovers the whole secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its T=O(n^(183/4)(log2 n)^(-1/2)2^((99/140)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)+5n^(1/4)sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law below. All constants are absolute. Every predicate is an expanded circuit; source/work guards, failed attempts, preparation, storage, full addressing and generation are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2. Deterministic exact rational-log preprocessing work O(n^16) and classical storage O(n^3) are included in these same envelopes; its large buffers are released before source/quantum work.

For the SAME MSR12 finite program in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and Q the ACTUAL number of source copies acquired including filters and discarded trees, the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch including source/work aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.
